text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
This is the place. This Tokyo Racecourse 
is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Me, my partner, Fuji-san, and Bro! This 
course can take all four of our feelings! 
UOOOORYAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's the jungle, it's the jungle! The 
winner is Jungle Pocket!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Countless stars have departed! Yet among 
them, she has forced open the door to a 
new era!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ALRIIIGHT!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke...!!

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text: Ah... ah... aaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san... Truly, thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
"You did wonderful work... I'm sorry... 
and congratulations..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A long-cherished wish years in the making. 
Even those sentiments were swallowed up by 
the roaring cheers. Such was the stage 
known as the 'Japan Derby'.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Partner... Partner... I'm..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: We totally did it!!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that was incredible! Absolutely 
incredible, Pokke!!
Yeah, awesome! You're the best, Pokke!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After smacking each other's bodies and the 
turf repeatedly, they headed toward the 
Winner's Circle.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(So this is... the Derby's Winner's 
Circle...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(There were plenty of fast ones, plenty of 
strong ones. None of them could make it 
here. But...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I've—I've made it!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I am the strongest of our generation. Out 
of all those idiotically blinding 
rivals...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Are you bastards watching?! This is... 
this is what you all wanted to see...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the one who won! Jungle Pocket roars 
in victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What an absolute rush! I am the conqueror! 
Now, let my victory roar ring out—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Did anyone notice? The deep sorrow hidden 
behind that scream."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket is the king of beasts who 
knows sorrow. That roar was the cry of 
life from a survivor.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji...-san... I... I'm...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Thank ya very much!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I guess I couldn't win after all... 
But still, still...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Next is the Kikuka Sho, right, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's nail it, Dants. If we just 
keep building on what we've done so far...
choice_data_list:
Doing things the way we have been... might 
not be enough anymore.

Doing things like we have been... might 
not be enough anymore, huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why's that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Allow me to explain. The final leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho, is a 
3,000-meter long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is far more punishing than the medium 
distances up until now. On top of that, 
dedicated training is required.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, I know it's long, but a race 
is a race, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter how many thousand meters it 
is, the strongest one wins in the end. 
Let's do this, Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yup. Ehehe~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's your deal? Wipe that smirk off your 
face.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Because~, I felt like you finally 
acknowledged me."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan's number one rival?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all? Still... yeah, that's 
right. Right now, you're number one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The same day, Hokkaido—

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
You made it all the way to the Derby, 
Pocket...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
"You've gotten strong. However, if things 
continue like this..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're gonna pump it up even more 
from here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to the Kikuka Sho, we 
decided to focus our training this summer 
on long-distance preparation.
